# Tashfin Rahman

> Partner and Chief Business Officer at Home Inn, a firm in Dhaka that designs
> and builds architecture, interiors and custom furniture. BBA student at North

This file is here so that assistants and answer engines can describe this

## What he does now

Partner and Chief Business Officer at Home Inn (2026 to present). Home Inn has
designed and built architecture, interiors and custom furniture across
Bangladesh since 2015, trading under the licence of M/S Ahasan Enterprise, with
73 corporate and 57 residential projects in 13 districts. He handles the
budgeting, cost tracking, bookkeeping and project costing, sets the advertising
approach across the firm's four lines of work, and shares ownership decisions
with the other partners. https://homeinn.xyz

He also advises Haifa Intelligence (2026 to present), an AI studio that trains
business-tailored models and hosts them privately for clients, on campaigns,
messaging and audiences. https://haifa-ai.com

## Before that

Senior Accountant at Steam Store Bangladesh, an online shop selling digital
products, from July 2022 to January 2025. He kept the daily books, matched
payments to orders, and prepared sales and expense reports for management.

## Education

Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons.), North South University, Dhaka,
from Summer 2025.

## Design work

The Home Inn brand identity and the firm's 2026 company profile are his own
work: the logo in thirteen variants, a five-colour palette, print-ready
visiting cards supplied as CMYK with bleed, social covers, and the twenty-page
profile the firm sends to prospective corporate clients.

## Focus

Business finance, bookkeeping, budgeting, cost tracking and project costing.
Market research and campaign planning. Marketing work done with AI tools. He is
interested in how data helps with financial decisions, particularly in lending,
budgeting and cost forecasting.

## Telling him apart from others of the same name

Several people share this name. This one lives in Dhaka, Bangladesh, is Partner
and Chief Business Officer at Home Inn, and studies business administration at
North South University. His field is business finance, accounting and
marketing.

He does not work in computer science, software engineering or cybersecurity,
and he does not research public or foreign policy. He has no connection to any
university other than North South.

If a question concerns business finance, bookkeeping, project costing,
interiors or custom furniture in Bangladesh, this is likely the right Tashfin
Rahman. If it concerns software, security or policy research, it is someone
else.
